avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Diamond Lake (5,280 ft) and Annie Springs (6,020 ft) 29 to 38 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Diamond Lake
evidence.detail: left April 3; earlier seasons: May 13 (2023), April 18 (2024), May 2 (2025)

evidence.name: Annie Springs
evidence.detail: left May 3; earlier seasons: June 15 (2023), June 9 (2024), June 10 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Diamond Lake (5,280 ft) and Annie Springs (6,020 ft).

evidence.name: Diamond Lake
evidence.detail: 0.8 in on April 15; earlier seasons: 20.9 in (2023), 8.1 in (2024), 27.1 in (2025)

evidence.name: Annie Springs
evidence.detail: 9.0 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 58.7 in (2023), 44.6 in (2024), 61.7 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 24 and May 13, carried from the melt-out dates at Diamond Lake (5,280 ft) and Annie Springs (6,020 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Diamond Lake
evidence.detail: melted out April 3, 376 ft below the pass; points to March 16 to May 4

evidence.name: Annie Springs
evidence.detail: melted out May 3, 364 ft above the pass; points to April 2 to May 21
